questions.question: After allowing a discount of 28%, an article is available for ₹3,240. Its marked price is _______.

questions.question: If the 6-digit number N84M69 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 11, the difference between the sums of alternate digits must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Sum of digits at odd places = N + 4 + 6 = N + 10

Sum of digits at even places = 8 + M + 9 = M + 17

Difference = (M + 17) − (N + 10) = M − N + 7

Equating the difference to 0 gives: M − N + 7 = 0 ⇒ M − N = −7

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number is N84M69.

The number is completely divisible by 11.

**Concept Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference of the alternating sum of its digits is exactly 0 or a multiple of 11 (such as 11, 22, -11).

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd positions (from left) = N + 4 + 6 = N + 10

⇒ Sum of digits at even positions (from left) = 8 + M + 9 = M + 17

⇒ Difference between the two sums = (M + 17) − (N + 10)

⇒ Difference = M − N + 7

⇒ For the number to be divisible by 11, M − N + 7 = 0, 11, 22, etc.

⇒ Case 1: M − N + 7 = 0 ⇒ M − N = −7

⇒ Case 2: M − N + 7 = 11 ⇒ M − N = 4

⇒ Checking the given options, the relation M − N = −7 is available as a valid relation.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is completely divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 or 9, respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11 and 13

A large number is divisible by 7, 11, or 13 if the alternating difference of blocks of three digits starting from right to left is a multiple of 7, 11, or 13.
</p

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 22 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 8 hours. The time taken by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is::

Total work = LCM(12, 22, 8) = 264 units.

Combined efficiency = (264 ÷ 12) + (264 ÷ 22) + (264 ÷ 8) = 22 + 12 + 33 = 67 units/hour.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 ⁶³/₆₇ hours.**

Combined Work Formula

questions.question: A train that is 220 m long overtakes a man moving at a speed of 10 km/hr (in same direction) in 44 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another train of a length of 315 m, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 79 km/hr?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of Train 1 and man = 220 ÷ 44 = 5 m/s = 18 km/hr.

Since they move in the same direction, Train 1 speed = 18 + 10 = 28 km/hr.

For crossing Train 2 in opposite direction, Relative Speed = 28 + 79 = 107 km/hr = 107 × (5 / 18) m/s.

Time to cross = Total Length ÷ Relative Speed = (220 + 315) ÷ [107 × (5 / 18)].

Time = 535 × 18 ÷ 535 = 18 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 220 m

Speed of man = 10 km/hr

Time taken to cross man = 44 seconds

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 315 m

Speed of Train 2 (V₂) = 79 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

km/hr to m/s conversion: multiply by 5/18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed of Train 1 and man = L₁ ÷ Time

⇒ Relative speed = 220 ÷ 44 = 5 m/s

⇒ Converting to km/hr = 5 × (18 ÷ 5) = 18 km/hr

⇒ Since both are moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = V₁ − Speed of man

⇒ V₁ − 10 = 18

⇒ V₁ = 28 km/hr

⇒ For crossing Train 2, Relative speed (opposite direction) = 28 + 79 = 107 km/hr

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 107 × (5 ÷ 18) = 535 / 18 m/s

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂ = 220 + 315 = 535 m

⇒ Time required = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 535 ÷ (535 ÷ 18)

⇒ Time = (535 × 18) ÷ 535 = 18 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = V₁ − V₂. In opposite directions, it is V₁ + V₂.

Crossing Objects

When a train crosses a stationary pole or moving man, the distance covered is just the length of the train. When crossing a platform or another train, the total distance is the sum of both lengths.

Speed Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

questions.question: Find the value of [868 ÷ {26 + 6 × (3 − 7)}].
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly to simplify the given expression.

⇒ 868 ÷ {26 + 6 × (3 − 7)}

⇒ 868 ÷ {26 + 6 × (−4)}

⇒ 868 ÷ {26 − 24}

⇒ 868 ÷ 2 = 434

**∴ The correct answer is 434.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 868 ÷ {26 + 6 × (3 − 7)}

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Step 1: Solve the innermost round brackets first.

⇒ (3 − 7) = −4

⇒ Expression becomes: 868 ÷ {26 + 6 × (−4)}

⇒ Step 2: Multiply the values inside the curly brackets.

⇒ 6 × (−4) = −24

⇒ Expression becomes: 868 ÷ {26 − 24}

⇒ Step 3: Perform addition/subtraction inside the curly brackets.

⇒ 26 − 24 = 2

⇒ Expression becomes: 868 ÷ 2

⇒ Step 4: Perform the final division.

⇒ 868 ÷ 2 = 434

**∴ The correct answer is 434.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Priority

Mathematical equations are solved strictly in this sequence: Brackets → Of → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction.

Order of Brackets

When solving multiple nested brackets, always proceed from inside out: Line bracket → Round brackets ( ) → Curly brackets { } → Square brackets [ ].

Sign Rules

Multiplying numbers with different signs yields a negative result: (+) × (−) = (−). Multiplying numbers with the same sign yields a positive result: (−) × (−) = (+).
</p

questions.question: Sapna invested ₹21,700 on simple interest, partly at 3% per annum and partly at 12% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 7 years, then find the sum invested at 3% per annum (in ₹).

Ratio of parts (P₁ : P₂) = R₂ : R₁ = 12 : 3 = 4 : 1

Total units = 4 + 1 = 5 units.

Since 5 units = ₹21,700, then 1 unit = ₹4,340.

Equal Simple Interest Rule

Equal Amount Rule

Effective Simple Interest

The overall accumulated simple interest percentage over T years is simply R × T %. The total SI amount is calculated directly as (R × T)% of the Principal.

questions.question: Which of the following is the greatest number that, when dividing 183, 127 and 211, leaves the same remainder each time?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The greatest number leaving the same remainder is the HCF of their absolute differences.

Differences = |183 − 127|, |211 − 127|, |211 − 183|

Differences = 56, 84, 28

Required Number = HCF(56, 84, 28) = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 183, 127, and 211.

**Formula Used:**

The greatest number that will divide x, y, and z leaving the same remainder in each case is given by the HCF of |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Difference 1 = |183 − 127| = 56

⇒ Difference 2 = |127 − 211| = 84

⇒ Difference 3 = |211 − 183| = 28

⇒ Now, we need to find the HCF of 56, 84, and 28.

⇒ Factors of 28 = 2 × 2 × 7

⇒ Factors of 56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7

⇒ Factors of 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7

⇒ The common factors are 2, 2, and 7.

⇒ HCF = 2 × 2 × 7 = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Greatest number leaving specific remainders

The greatest number that divides x, y, and z leaving remainders a, b, and c respectively is the HCF of (x − a), (y − b), and (z − c).

Smallest number leaving the same remainder

The smallest number which when divided by x, y, and z leaves the same remainder r in each case is LCM(x, y, z) + r.

LCM and HCF Relation

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: A × B = HCF × LCM.
</p

questions.question: Simplify:(sin Atan A)/((1-cosA))
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let us assume an angle, say A = 60°.

Value of given expression = (sin 60° × tan 60°) / (1 − cos 60°)

⇒ [(√3 / 2) × √3] / (1 − 1/2) = (3/2) / (1/2) = 3

Checking the options, only Option 1 yields: 1 + sec 60° = 1 + 2 = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 + sec A.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(sin A × tan A) / (1 − cos A)

**Formulas Used:**

tan A = sin A / cos A

sin² A = 1 − cos² A

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ [sin A × (sin A / cos A)] / (1 − cos A)

⇒ (sin² A / cos A) / (1 − cos A)

⇒ sin² A / [cos A × (1 − cos A)]

Substituting sin² A = 1 − cos² A:

⇒ (1 − cos² A) / [cos A × (1 − cos A)]

⇒ [(1 − cos A)(1 + cos A)] / [cos A × (1 − cos A)]

⇒ (1 + cos A) / cos A

⇒ (1 / cos A) + (cos A / cos A)

⇒ sec A + 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1 + sec A.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

sin² A + cos² A = 1 | sec² A − tan² A = 1 | cosec² A − cot² A = 1

Reciprocal Relations

sin A = 1 / cosec A | cos A = 1 / sec A | tan A = 1 / cot A

Value Substitution Method

When simplifying trigonometric expressions, assuming standard angles like 30°, 45°, or 60° helps eliminate incorrect options quickly. Always avoid angles that make the denominator zero (e.g., A = 0° in this case).
</p

questions.question: The product of two consecutive natural numbers is 182. The greater of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two consecutive natural numbers, their product is close to the square of either number.

√182 ≈ 13.49

The consecutive natural numbers closest to 13.49 are 13 and 14.

Since 13 × 14 = 182, the two numbers are indeed 13 and 14.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The product of two consecutive natural numbers is 182.

**Method Used:**

Let the two consecutive natural numbers be x and (x + 1).

**Calculations:**

⇒ x(x + 1) = 182

⇒ x² + x = 182

⇒ x² + x − 182 = 0

⇒ x² + 14x − 13x − 182 = 0

⇒ x(x + 14) − 13(x + 14) = 0

⇒ (x − 13)(x + 14) = 0

⇒ x = 13 or x = −14

⇒ Since x must be a positive natural number, we reject −14 and take x = 13.

⇒ The two consecutive numbers are 13 and 13 + 1 = 14.

⇒ The greater number among the two is 14.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Natural Numbers

Counting numbers starting from 1 (1, 2, 3, ...). They do not include zero, fractions, decimals, or negative numbers.

Consecutive Numbers

Numbers that follow each other continuously from smallest to largest without any gaps (e.g., n, n+1, n+2).

Quadratic Equation

An equation of the form ax² + bx + c = 0. The roots can be found by factorisation or by using the quadratic formula x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a.
</p

Third Proportional

Mean Proportional

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 44 cm, 33 cm, and 55 cm. What is its area? (in cm² )

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sides of the triangle are 33 cm, 44 cm, and 55 cm.

Ratio of sides = 33 : 44 : 55 = 3 : 4 : 5

Since the sides form a Pythagorean triplet, the triangle is right-angled.

Area of a right-angled triangle = 1/2 × Base × Perpendicular Height

Area = 1/2 × 33 × 44 = 33 × 22 = 726

**∴ The correct answer is 726 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit or loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 and Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always offered on the Marked Price (MP). The Selling Price (SP) after a discount is calculated as SP = MP × (100 − Discount %) ÷ 100.

Relationship between CP, SP and MP

A direct relationship combining profit and discount is: CP × (100 + Profit %) = MP × (100 − Discount %).

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divides 3,27,087?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the divisibility rule of 3, a number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.

Sum of digits of 3,27,087 = 3 + 2 + 7 + 0 + 8 + 7 = 27.

Since 27 is perfectly divisible by 3, the entire number is also divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number to be checked is 3,27,087.

**Method Used:**

We apply standard divisibility rules for each given option to find the exact divisor.

**Calculations:**

⇒ **For 12:** A number must be divisible by both 3 and 4. The last two digits (87) are odd and not divisible by 4. So, it is not divisible by 12.

⇒ **For 8:** Any number divisible by 8 must be an even number. Since 3,27,087 ends in 7, it is odd and cannot be divisible by 8.

⇒ **For 5:** A number is divisible by 5 only if its last digit is 0 or 5. Here, the last digit is 7, so it is not divisible by 5.

⇒ **For 3:** The sum of the digits = 3 + 2 + 7 + 0 + 8 + 7 = 27.

⇒ As 27 is divisible by 3, the given number 3,27,087 is perfectly divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 9

Similar to the rule of 3, a number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its individual digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and the sum of digits at even positions is either 0 or perfectly divisible by 11.

questions.question: 4 men can complete a piece of work in 18 days, while 9 women can do it in 8 days. In how many days can 3 women and 6 men complete this work?

⇒ Time = 72 ÷ (3 × 1 + 6 × 1) = 72 ÷ 9 = 8 days
